messages:
sasha: Heads up — starting a targeted admin entitlement sweep focused on ephemeral elevations and KMS-accessing principals. Goal: produce evidence for entitlements + justification for any temp admins created in last 90 days. Who can help with KMS access logs and CloudTrail joins?

jamie: I can pull CloudTrail events for KMS. Want CSV or a BigQuery dump?

priya: CSV is fine. Also need to know which principals are service accounts vs people — tag mapping in identity-service should help.

mohit: Noted. Heads up: our KMS is multi-key; some older keys have separate key policies that bypass IAM logs — watch for "kms:ViaService" entries. Also some temporary roles were created via terraform import, not human-approved.

irene: For justification evidence we need the "requestor" field from the elevation ticket (ops-privs). Can access-bot correlate ticket IDs from role-session tags?

access-bot: auto: I can join CloudTrail events with ops-privs tickets if session tag "x-request-id" present. I will run a join and output CSV to /tmp/admin-sweep-2469123456.csv in 15m.

sasha: Perfect. Mohit — can you run the KMS keypolicy scan and flag keys with non-owner principals? Paste command you used.

mohit: sure — here's the grep one-liner I used:

```
aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' --output text | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms get-key-policy --key-id {} --policy | jq '.Statement[] | {Principal,Action,Condition}'
```

priya: small ask — include last_used timestamp for each principal; we want to remove admin flags for principals not used in 60d.

jamie: I'll add lastSeen from identity-service and join on principal ARN before we dump.

irene: Also: we should keep an escape path for oncall. Proposal: any admin removal must create a temp-break-glass role with 4-hr TTL and 2-person approval. Thoughts?

sasha: +1. Documenting: action items — (1) jamie export CSV + join lastSeen (2) access-bot produce evidence CSV with ticket IDs (3) mohit run keypolicy scan and list suspect keys (4) irene draft removal playbook including break-glass. I'll own coordination and send to compliance by EOD Friday.

priya: I'll do a quick dry-run in the test account first and leave notes.

jamie: CSV link when ready: https://files.redwood.internal/sweeps/admin-sweep-2469123456.csv :thumbsup: 

sasha: thanks everyone. If anyone hits missing CloudTrail for a region tell me — some logging filters dropped eu-west-3 earlier.
